adenomas can already by stratified into CMS classes, with the CMS3 ‘metabolically’ subtype most prevalent among adenoma, consistent with the low risk of these tumours of progressing to malignancies, whereas CMS2 is relatively enriched with adenomas with high risk of progression to malignancy.

adenomas can already stratified into the four consensus molecular subtypes of CRC, and that the distribution of the consensus molecular subtypes among adenomas is associated with risk of progression to CRC.

the classification of colorectal tumours into molecular subtypes, and with the relationship between the molecular subtypes and progression to malignancy.
